definitions.explanation: The place or point where something begins; can be used both literally (for journeys) and figuratively (for arguments, careers, etc.).

examples.japanese: ここが{議論|ぎろん}の{出発点|しゅっぱつてん}だ。
examples.english: This is the starting point of the discussion.

examples.japanese: {出発点|しゅっぱつてん}に{戻|もど}る。
examples.english: To return to the starting point.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{出発点|しゅっぱつてん}に{立|た}つ。
examples.english: To stand at a new starting point.

notes:
Compound of {出発|しゅっぱつ} (departure) + {点|てん} (point). Used both literally for physical journeys and figuratively for ideas, arguments, and careers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出発点|しゅっぱつてん}に{立|た}つ: to stand at a starting point
- {出発点|しゅっぱつてん}に{戻|もど}る: to return to the starting point
- {新|あたら}しい{出発点|しゅっぱつてん}: a new starting point
- {議論|ぎろん}の{出発点|しゅっぱつてん}: the starting point of a discussion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {起点|きてん}: starting point, origin (often for routes or measurements)
- {原点|げんてん}: origin, starting point (implies going back to fundamentals: {原点|げんてん}に{返|かえ}る)
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}: departure (the act of leaving, not the location)
